compute.cost_note: local; pypdf text-layer extraction is fast; OCR via ocrmypdf is slow and needs system binaries

do_not_use_when: the inventory rows lack the impostor fields the manifest validator requires
the PDFs are remote URLs (use acquire_pdf_urls)
image-only PDFs matter and the OCR layer (ocrmypdf plus tesseract, ghostscript, qpdf) is not installed; those rows are skipped

examples.description: Text-layer-only first pass over a filtered inventory

purpose: extract plain text from a user-filtered pdf_inventory JSONL into the private impostor pool (pypdf text layer, or ocrmypdf for image-only and mixed PDFs unless --skip-ocr), writing .txt + .meta.json per PDF and draft manifest entries with corpus_role impostor.
use_when: you ran pdf_inventory, kept the rows that should join the pool, and annotated them with persona, register, register_match, topic_match, consent_status, era and impostor_for
building an academic or report-register impostor pool from a local PDF library
